retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, sun-drenched outdoor scene featuring a bearded man in workwear seated next to a large boat hull, utilizing high-contrast natural lighting and wide-tracked sans-serif type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, high-contrast photograph of a man with a beard and sunglasses sitting in a lawn chair. He is positioned in the lower right, framed by the massive, weathered hull of a boat on a trailer that dominates the left side. The lighting is harsh, creating deep shadows and bright highlights on the sandy ground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in lower right balanced by large boat hull on the left
Harsh direct sunlight creating high-contrast shadows
Text placed horizontally across the mid-section, bridging the two main visual elements
Earthy, muted color palette of olive green, dusty blue, and warm sand

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is seated in the lower right quadrant, occupying approximately one-quarter of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-blue boat hull on the left acts as the primary visual anchor and framing device.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the boat hull, follows the horizontal line of the text across the center, and rests on the seated man.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the center and upper right provide negative space that emphasizes the subject and the boat.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and grey of the boat hull
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows and dark olive green jacket
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan sand and small red patches on the jacket
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between sunlit areas and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and weathered industrial hues

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified across the frame

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the boat hull and the dark background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title to maintain a utilitarian, cohesive look.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the center axis

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, modern yet sturdy feel of the lettering.
Provides a similar open, geometric structure suitable for wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a bearded man in an olive green work jacket and sunglasses sitting in a lawn chair. To his left, a large, weathered light-blue boat hull on a trailer dominates the frame. The setting is a sandy outdoor area with harsh, direct sunlight creating deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name on the left over the boat hull and the title on the right over the dark background using a medium-weight, uppercase geometric sans-serif font with very wide tracking in an off-white color.

verificationChecks: Is the boat hull the dominant element on the left?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?
Is the text uppercase with wide tracking?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Weathered textures on the boat and trailer

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background
Check that the man's posture feels candid and relaxed
Verify the boat hull texture looks aged and worn
Confirm the shadows are deep and well-defined
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large, textured industrial object on one side with a candid human subject on the other, bridged by wide-tracked, minimalist typography.
